name: Seeded traits demonstration

founders.label: Odd founders carry a reserve chamber, present at creation; even founders carry none

question: Does storing surplus energy change who is left when food stops?
expectedObservationsText: Seeded traits demonstration: the reserve chambers were given to alternate founders when the dish was made (present at creation); they are starting variation, not a discovery. 24 identical Sprinters share one sugar meal (0.50 per cell within r 6). In the stable copy the same meal is added again at 60, 120, 180, 240 and 300 s; in the single-meal copy it is not. A reserve chamber adds room for 40 more energy but costs 0.05 energy per second and gives no energy by itself. Either group may leave more descendants, or neither.
